SELECT 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt1, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt2, 
  cd_credit_rating, 
  COUNT(*) AS cnt3 
FROM 
  customer c 
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
WHERE 
  ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME') 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM (
      SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk 
      FROM store_sales ss 
      JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
      WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
      UNION ALL
      SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk 
      FROM web_sales ws 
      JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
      WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
      UNION ALL
      SELECT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk 
      FROM catalog_sales cs 
      JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
      WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS sales_customers 
    WHERE sales_customers.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  ) 
GROUP BY 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  cd_credit_rating 
ORDER BY 
  cd_gender, 
  cd_marital_status, 
  cd_education_status, 
  cd_purchase_estimate, 
  cd_credit_rating 
LIMIT 100
